**Stable ID:** `DATA-03.04` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 03 Modality coverage

Define how datasets that pair modalities record their component modalities, alignment and pairing provenance.

## Deliverables

- Multimodal profile referencing component modality profiles
- Alignment and pairing provenance fields

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/TAXONOMY.md`
- `schemas/modalities/multimodal.schema.json`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Profile cites the documentation conventions it adopts

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each multimodal record lists component modalities using existing profiles
- [ ] Pairing method and alignment source are required or explicitly unknown
- [ ] Validator enforces the profile
